title: Design Challenge

items: Blank paper for each student’s solo sketch; the worksheet is one per team
One set of pencils, markers and coloured pencils per team, so no team waits to share
A timer everyone can see; the steps are short

items.title: Sketch alone
items.text: Each student sketches one idea in silence, or tells you it. Say it’s a quick idea, not a finished drawing, and give a one-minute warning.

items.title: Share ideas
items.text: About a minute each: show the sketch, then teammates name one idea to keep. Time each turn, or the first speaker uses up the slot.

items.title: Agree and design
items.text: The team draws ONE cupcake on its worksheet and labels three teamwork qualities. Keep the solo sketches on the table, and pass the worksheet so each student adds a part. At the halfway point every team should be drawing, not still debating.

blocks.text: Build one cupcake from parts: the base from one sketch, the frosting from another, a topping from a third.

items: Every student’s idea shows up in the team cupcake.
Three teamwork qualities, such as communication, inclusion, creativity, trust or collaboration.
